{"consolidated_memory":"**INTERMITTENT EOF IN crypto/tls/handshake.go - MULTIPLE OCCASIONS**

A recurring class of intermittent EOF errors in the TLS handshake (crypto/tls/handshake.go, security side) has been encountered and fixed across six separate occasions. All share a common reproducibility pattern (open many short-lived connections in a row) and signal (unexpected end of stream during negotiation). Each occasion had a distinct trigger, root cause, and outcome.

**Occasion 1 [2026-03-23]:**
- Trigger: Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Outcome: Cold start dropped 8 percent, to 898 ms
- Fix: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #5168 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-1

**Occasion 2 [2026-05-22]:**
- Trigger: Only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: Error swallowed by a bare except
- Outcome: Error rate dropped from 4.4 percent to under 2 per ten thousand
- Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #5652 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-2

**Occasion 3 [2026-05-30]:**
- Trigger: Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
- Outcome: Flaky test went from 32 failures per hundred runs to zero
- Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #6269 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-3

**Occasion 4 [2026-05-31]:**
- Trigger: Only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Outcome: Reclaimed 81 GB of blob storage
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #6850 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-4
- Stack: Go; covering test: crypto/tls/handshake_test.go

**Occasion 5 [2026-06-04]:**
- Trigger: Only for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Outcome: Memory settled at 307 MB instead of climbing past 8 GB
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #7356 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-5

**Occasion 6 [2026-07-22]:**
- Trigger: Only when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Outcome: Backlog cleared 7 minutes after the deploy
- Fix: Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #9065 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-6

All work occurred in the same corner of crypto/tls/handshake.go, with context carried over between occasions."}
